scenario: A weather app requests background location access.

supported_findings: The app requests ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION in addition to foreground location access, allowing location queries even when not in active use.
The single logged connection to weather-api.example.com transferring 1500 bytes is consistent with a routine forecast-data request.
Background location access is broader than strictly necessary for on-demand forecast lookup, though it is a plausible design choice for a weather app offering location-based alerts.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that background location was used for tracking a person's movements -- no repeated or pattern-of-life location traffic appears in this case.
Any claim asserting malicious intent from a single, function-consistent network request.
